decisionPolicy: Each pre-repository decision ID D-001 through D-089 has exactly one canonical owner in DECISIONS-LEDGER.md; supportingReferences are non-owning trace links.

decisions.title: Product Name
decisions.decision: SPRYXEL
notes: Formal trademark/domain clearance required before public launch.

decisions.title: Product Category
decisions.decision: AI Game Asset Platform, not generic AI image generator.

decisions.title: Target Audience
decisions.decision: Indie developers, solo developers, vibe coders and AI-native game builders.

decisions.title: Asset Scope
decisions.decision: Architecture must support pixel, 2D, 2.5D and 3D. Delivery will be incremental.

decisions.title: Developer Interfaces
decisions.decision: API and MCP are first-class product surfaces; CLI is planned.

decisions.title: Languages
decisions.decision: English canonical/default; PT-BR and Spanish localized UI.

decisions.title: Development Environment
decisions.decision: Local-first Docker with RTX 5050 as primary development inference hardware.

decisions.title: Initial Infrastructure
decisions.decision: Use free tiers wherever commercially permitted; external GPU is pay-per-use/serverless until scale justifies dedicated capacity.

decisions.title: Credit Economics
decisions.decision: Ledger-based credits with pre-generation reservation and CostGuard.

decisions.title: Anti-Abuse
decisions.decision: TrustShield risk graph; no single-signal multi-account bans.

decisions.title: Refund Strategy
decisions.decision: Do not obstruct statutory rights. Protect the company using trial design, new-account exposure caps, reserves, evidence, antifraud, cost pricing and hard limits.

decisions.title: Commercial Safety
decisions.decision: No generation without bounded cost authorization.

decisions.title: Product Navigation Model
decisions.decision: Organize SPRYXEL by game-production job, not AI model/provider.

decisions.title: Canonical Asset Model
decisions.decision: Assets are versioned entities with metadata, lineage, DNA and provenance, not mere files.

decisions.title: Asset Families
decisions.decision: SPRYXEL supports coherent asset families/packs as a first-class concept.

decisions.title: V1 Asset Focus
decisions.decision: V1 focuses on Pixel + 2D while platform architecture remains ready for 2.5D and 3D.

decisions.title: Model Abstraction
decisions.decision: Model/provider selection is hidden behind the Model Router and Generation SKU contracts.

decisions.title: Agent Budgeting
decisions.decision: MCP/API calls must support bounded spend/retries and machine-readable budget errors.

decisions.title: Economic Benchmark Metric
decisions.decision: Optimize for cost per accepted production asset, not merely cost per inference attempt.

decisions.title: Repair Strategy
decisions.decision: Prefer targeted repair over full regeneration when quality and economics justify it.

decisions.title: Production Asset Gate
decisions.decision: Raw AI output cannot become an approved asset without required QA gates.

decisions.title: Anatomy Quality
decisions.decision: Anatomy/topology validation is mandatory for applicable character/creature SKUs.

decisions.title: Resolution-Aware Anatomy
decisions.decision: Anatomy validation must respect pixel resolution; tiny sprites are validated semantically/silhouette-wise rather than requiring impossible photorealistic finger detail.

decisions.title: Asset Contract
decisions.decision: Every generation compiles to an explicit Asset Contract before inference.

decisions.title: Multi-Signal QA
decisions.decision: No single probabilistic vision model may be the sole production approval mechanism for anatomy-sensitive assets.

decisions.title: Targeted Repair
decisions.decision: Localized repair is preferred to full regeneration when it is cheaper and expected to meet quality.

decisions.title: Model Eligibility
decisions.decision: Production models require verified commercial eligibility, quality benchmark and known economics.

decisions.title: Qwen-Image-2.1
decisions.decision: Benchmark/research candidate only under current Qwen Research License; not a commercial SPRYXEL production dependency at this stage.

decisions.title: Initial Commercial-Friendly Model Shortlist
decisions.decision: Prioritize benchmarking Z-Image, FLUX.1-schnell and HiDream-O1-Image because current published licenses are commercially friendlier (Apache-2.0 / MIT), subject to final license review.

decisions.title: ComfyUI Boundary
decisions.decision: ComfyUI is an inference/workflow adapter and R&D environment, not the owner of billing/business invariants.

decisions.title: Control Plane Architecture
decisions.decision: Start with a modular-monolith control plane and independently scalable AI workers; no premature microservice split.

decisions.title: PostgreSQL Canonical State
decisions.decision: PostgreSQL is canonical for users/projects/assets/jobs/ledger state; transient provider/queue state cannot replace it.

decisions.title: Local Profiles
decisions.decision: Docker development uses profiles so 24 GB RAM / 8 GB VRAM are not overwhelmed by unnecessary simultaneous services.

decisions.title: Benchmark Metric
decisions.decision: Track explicit anatomy defect rates and cost per accepted asset, not generic image quality alone.

decisions.title: Dual Quality Layer
decisions.decision: Integrity Gate is binary and independent from Production Score.

decisions.title: Critical Defect Supremacy
decisions.decision: Aesthetic quality can never override a critical structural failure.

decisions.title: Resolution Profiles
decisions.decision: Pixel QA/anatomy rules vary by target resolution.

decisions.title: V1 SKU Contracts
decisions.decision: V1 generation operations are versioned SKUs with explicit asset contracts and bounded retries.

decisions.title: Four-Direction Identity
decisions.decision: A four-direction character set is accepted only if all directions preserve one character identity.

decisions.title: Baseline / Scale Control
decisions.decision: Character families use explicit baseline and scale-drift rules.

decisions.title: Benchmark Promotion
decisions.decision: No model/pipeline reaches paid production from subjective review alone.

decisions.title: Golden Asset Suite
decisions.decision: Generation changes require versioned regression benchmarks.

decisions.title: Failed Quality Billing
decisions.decision: Hard-gate-invalid generation is not treated as a valid delivered production asset for full-charge purposes.

decisions.title: Cost Attribution
decisions.decision: Credit economics use the entire attempt/retry/QA/repair cost, not the winning inference only.

decisions.title: Maps as First-Class System
decisions.decision: map creation is a dedicated SPRYXEL product domain, not a side feature.

decisions.title: Multi-Layer Map Scope
decisions.decision: SPRYXEL must support world, region, local, dungeon/interior and minimap layers conceptually.

decisions.title: Hybrid Map Direction
decisions.decision: SPRYXEL should pursue hybrid structured/procedural + AI-assisted map workflows where useful.

decisions.title: UI/HUD as First-Class Asset Family
decisions.decision: menus, HUD, inventory/backpack and screen systems are first-class product surfaces.

decisions.title: Maps and UI Share Project DNA
decisions.decision: maps, minimaps, markers and UI assets must participate in the same project style system.

decisions.title: Combined Workflow Packs
decisions.decision: map/UI bundles such as world navigation packs and backpack UI packs are valid workflow-level outputs.

decisions.title: Map SKUs
decisions.decision: map production is represented by explicit versioned SKUs, not generic image generation.

decisions.title: Structured Dungeon First
decisions.decision: dungeon generation should support structure-first graph generation before visual rendering.

decisions.title: Map Layer Contract
decisions.decision: structured map layers must be dimension-aligned and machine-addressable.

decisions.title: UI Pack SKUs
decisions.decision: HUD, backpack, menus and screen systems are packaged as coherent multi-component SKUs.

decisions.title: Localization-Safe UI
decisions.decision: UI generation must be localization-safe for English, PT-BR and Spanish.

decisions.title: Engine-Agnostic Canonical Export
decisions.decision: canonical assets remain engine-independent; EngineBridge performs Godot/Unity adaptation.

decisions.title: Agent Map/UI APIs
decisions.decision: maps and UI receive first-class MCP/API operations with bounded budgets and idempotency.

decisions.title: Non-Destructive World Evolution
decisions.decision: map versioning should preserve stable region/POI identities when feasible.

decisions.title: Canonical Cost Currency
decisions.decision: USD is canonical internal cost currency; BRL is secondary owner-reporting currency.

decisions.title: Abstract Credits
decisions.decision: Spryxel Credits are abstract non-cash usage units with no permanently fixed currency value.

decisions.title: Full Redemption Safety
decisions.decision: paid packs must remain profitable assuming 100% credit redemption.

decisions.title: Trial Entitlements
decisions.decision: free trial defaults to restricted SKU entitlements instead of generic free SC.

decisions.title: Zero Public Free Cloud Budget
decisions.decision: default public free-cloud budget is zero until explicitly funded by the owner/campaign.

decisions.title: Credit-Pack First Launch
decisions.decision: initial commercial model prioritizes prepaid credit packs; subscriptions are deferred until usage/retention data exists.

decisions.title: Billing Abstraction
decisions.decision: payment-provider semantics live behind a BillingProvider adapter.

decisions.title: Early Global MoR Candidate
decisions.decision: Paddle is the preferred early global Merchant-of-Record candidate for further validation; Stripe remains a first-class direct-payment alternative.

decisions.title: Small-Pack Guard
decisions.decision: avoid tiny paid packs that are disproportionately consumed by fixed transaction fees; $10 is an initial simulation floor, not a final price.

decisions.title: Working Capital Gate
decisions.decision: public paid cloud inference requires a working-capital reserve independent of booked revenue.

decisions.title: Margin Guardrails
decisions.decision: target >=70% base contribution margin; launch models must also remain >=60% in conservative and >=30% in approved severe stress simulations.

decisions.title: Hard Negative-Margin Stop
decisions.decision: CostGuard prevents new affected jobs when predicted contribution margin is non-positive.

decisions.title: Stress Simulation
decisions.decision: every pack/SKU is tested against GPU, FX, quality-regression, refund, chargeback, fraud, free-farming, heavy-user and worst-mix scenarios.

decisions.title: No Cross-Subsidized Hidden Loss
decisions.decision: no normal paid SKU may knowingly lose money and depend on low usage to hide the loss.

decisions.title: Pricing Freeze
decisions.decision: public prices remain simulation-only until measured benchmark COGS and legal/accounting/payment inputs are available.

decisions.title: Graph-Based TrustShield
decisions.decision: Multi-account/fraud uses graph + multiple signals, never IP-only.

decisions.title: Promotional Eligibility Separation
decisions.decision: Account and free-value eligibility are independent.

decisions.title: Privacy-Preserving Device Signal
decisions.decision: First-party pseudonymous token; invasive fingerprinting is not a V1 dependency.

decisions.title: Turnstile V1
decisions.decision: Cloudflare Turnstile preferred for V1 bot verification with server validation.

decisions.title: Ephemeral IDs
decisions.decision: Optional future Enterprise enhancement only.

decisions.title: Rules Before ML
decisions.decision: TrustShield v1 uses rules/graph/provider signals.

decisions.title: No Auto-Delete by Score
decisions.decision: Automated risk score alone cannot permanently delete account.

decisions.title: Trial Cluster Rule
decisions.decision: Strong-linked accounts may share one promotional eligibility.

decisions.title: Payment Tokenization
decisions.decision: No raw card storage; provider identifiers only.

decisions.title: Admin MFA
decisions.decision: Production owner/admin requires MFA.

decisions.title: Agent Budget Inheritance
decisions.decision: Nested agent calls consume one bounded workflow budget.

decisions.title: OAuth-First Remote MCP
decisions.decision: Interactive remote MCP prefers OAuth.

decisions.title: Scoped API Keys
decisions.decision: Keys are one-time revealed, hashed, scoped, budgeted and revocable.

decisions.title: False Positive Recovery
decisions.decision: Review/appeal plus false-positive metrics required.

decisions.title: Security Kill Switches
decisions.decision: Independent shutdown controls for signups, trials, referrals, agent mutations, purchases and generation.

decisions.title: Security Data Minimization
decisions.decision: Each security signal requires purpose, necessity, access and retention documentation.
